# CMakeLists.txt, e.g.:
#
#   add_subdirectory(Middlewares/U8g2)
#   target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE u8g2)
#
# The Arduino C++ wrapper (cppsrc/U8g2lib.cpp, U8x8lib.cpp) is NOT compiled
# by upstream's target - see README.md.
